applicant.name: Dr. Stefan Wallner
applicant.organisation: Clinical Institute for Nephrology, university hospital

purpose: Research on the burden of chronic kidney disease to inform referral pathways between hospitals.
question: How many patients with chronic kidney disease does each hospital hold, split by sex, and what is their mean kidney function?
definitions: Chronic kidney disease = any diagnosis of chronic kidney disease, whatever the stage.
Hospital = the data holder of the patient record.
Kidney function = eGFR (LOINC 62238-1); use the latest value per patient. Patients without an eGFR are left out of the mean.
Report per hospital and sex: patients with chronic kidney disease and the mean latest eGFR, one decimal.
